values.note: Potable water May 1 - September 30. Firewood for sale; boat launch.

note: MT State Park 5 mi S of Seeley Lake on Salmon Lake (MT-83), in larch, pine and fir woods on the Clearwater River chain of lakes; hard-surface roads and driveways, boat launch; nearest dump 7 mi S at Clearwater Jct. --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica (3-month window, 1 day ahead), season May 1 - Sept 30, showers/flush+vault toilets/water (derived values now verified). Changed sites 20 -> 24 (23 campsites + hike-bike) and max_rig_ft 25 -> 46, added 50-amp electric at 16 sites and pull-throughs. Not stated: fcfs, max stay (inherited), dump (derived false left). Fees left as recorded (FWP page only gives the statewide $4-$34 range). Note: wrong site count/length and restated values dropped.
